title: PayloadReadyPayload
description: Payload of the PayloadReady event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required. Dedupe key: docUuid+version (FR-M.12) — submission-svc's idempotent consumption of this at-least-once, idempotent-consumption-mandatory event keys on this pair, not on the envelope id alone. Bytes added 25 Sep 2026 (AD-30): submission-svc holds them with the queue item (FR-J.4); evidence-svc seals them as transmitted on SubmissionDespatched.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

payloadBytes.description: The built payload bytes, base64-encoded (opaque to this schema). A payload over 10 MB raises PAY-010 and yields PayloadRejected instead of PayloadReady (FR-4.13); inbound documents are at most 1 MB (VP-78), so payloads are normally far smaller.

amendmentClass.description: The amendment class this version represents relative to its predecessor (model/architecture/amendment-taxonomy.yaml); present when this version amends a prior one, absent on a document's first version.
